== Notes ==
* Unlike [[Judge's Insight]], this skill sets [[Armor penetration#Base armor penetration|base armor penetration]] directly to 10%, and therefore does not [[Effect stacking|stack]] with other sources that modify this value, such as the warrior's [[Strength]] bonus or that of a [[Penetrating Blow]].
* Good synergy with any [[attack skill]] requiring [[Cracked Armor]] (such as [[Body Blow]], [[Body Shot]] and [[Chest Thumper]]), as Cracked Armor applies before the attack skill hits; this also means that the attack benefits from the armor rating reduction.
